text:
rina: Noticing some onboarding-dev pain: sample-app customers hit 401 -> refresh -> 429 and observe duplicate side-effects from POSTs. Repro in staging when using short retry windows.
chao: Which SDKs are affected? Any pattern on headers (Retry-After, Idempotency-Key)?
rina: Mostly Go and Node. Go client retries the request body after refresh; Node sometimes replays only when idempotency header is missing. Headers from a trace: 
```
POST /webhook
Authorization: Bearer <old-token>
Idempotency-Key: (sometimes missing)
Response 401 -> token refresh -> retry -> Response 429 (no Retry-After) -> SDK retry -> duplicate delivery
```
sam: Sounds like two bugs colliding: auth-refresh concurrency + retry policy that doesn't respect "non-idempotent across refresh unless key present" rule.
priya: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigations: 
- SDKs MUST NOT auto-retry non-idempotent mutating requests across an auth refresh unless an explicit idempotency-key header is present.
- If server returns Retry-After, SDK backoff should honor it (convert secs to ms, cap to 5s).
- Default 429 backoff: base=40ms, multiplier=2, cap=1500ms, full jitter.
- Expose an opt-in config flag `enable_safe_replay` (false by default) for integrators that want automatic replay semantics for mutating calls.
chao: For streaming/long-poll endpoints we should avoid exponential full jitter; use small-linears (e.g., 100ms + uniform(0, 100ms)) to preserve resume semantics.
rina: I'll open a small sample-app patch showing two patterns: a) attach idempotency-key to mutating routes by default, b) use a token-rotation hook that queues in-flight mutating calls until refresh completes. Example token hook snippet we want in sample app: 
```go
// pseudo
client.OnTokenRefresh(func(old, new string){
  queue.BlockingFlush()
})
```
sam: Also add a quick lint in the sample-app CI: `dx-idemp-lint` that fails builds if a POST to /webhook or /orders lacks an idempotency header OR an explicit comment opt-out. Helps the onboarding flow.
devx-bot: New pipeline job added: dx-idemp-lint (rules: POST /orders, /webhook must have Idempotency-Key or // dx:allow-unsafe-replay comment).
deploy-bot: Alert created: duplicate-side-effect-rate > 0.3% over 10m -> ticket #1287.
priya: Long-term: SDK parity RFC to include Node/Python/Go rules: auth refresh ordering, backoff defaults, honor Retry-After, enable_safe_replay opt-in semantics, and sample-app examples. Keep RFC compact (1 page + code).
chao: For the Go SDK note: ensure transport layer doesn't retry requests with bodies unless the body implements Rewindable interface or idempotency-key present.
rina: I'll draft PRs: sample-app changes + dx-rfc-auth-429. Assign reviewers @chao @priya.
sam: Thanks; once merged we should update onboarding checklist and single-sentence note in the quickstart about idempotency header.
priya: I'll add the checklist blurb and a short trouble-shooting note for customers who hit 401/429 duplicates.
rina: Thanks all :thumbsup:
